summary: Confidence must fall when the corpus does not speak with one voice, counting mixed and inconclusive works as uncertainty — study count alone is not evidence quality.
reason: The agreement term divides by the DIRECTIONAL count only, so a corpus of one supporting work and thirty inconclusive ones scored a perfect 1.0 on agreement: a corpus that knows almost nothing looked unanimous. Volume then rewarded sheer size, so a hundred works that cancel out outranked ten that agree. A dispersion factor computed over the TOTAL work count and applied multiplicatively fixes the ordering without touching the verdict, the consensus score, or the strength ladder — a regen must keep confidence answering 'how consistent is this corpus', not 'how big is it'. The same relevant subset must reach both commands, so the PICO gate runs in compare/batch too.
validated_outcome: Pre-change confidence values (0.702727 / 0.668182 / 0.164606 / 0.97 / 0) were recorded against the unmodified formula and are pinned as a toggle-off regression test, so phase4ConfidenceEnabled=false reproduces the old numbers exactly; full go test suite green.
